approval_anchor.order: STMX EI NUMERIC V1 — FINAL REPRESENTATION CORRECTION + RUNTIME CLOSURE §4–§9
approval_anchor.reason: D2 representation gap — an identical admitted exposure observation (Upper Thigh / E04 / RESOLVED-STRONG) must yield different Numeric tiers because one exposure is inherent to ordinary realization and the other is opening-mediated. The exposure carrier records WHICH REGION is exposed and nothing about how it is produced.
approval_anchor.affected_scope: exposure_opening evidence carrier — subordinate metadata only

storage: exposure_opening.realization_qualifiers[] = [{ region, mode, authority, date, basis }]
★_placement: ★ Metadata SUBORDINATE to the existing exposure_opening carrier, bound to a specific Class-A region.
⛔_what_it_is_not: ⛔ NOT a new top-level garment parameter — parameter count remains 37
⛔ NOT a tenth exposure_opening value — the 9-value domain is unchanged

modes.INHERENT_PERSISTENT: The body-region exposure is created by the garment's ordinary realized coverage/cut and remains materially visible in ordinary neutral wear. It does not require a limb extended through an opening, a slit to spread materially, garment displacement, or a pose-dependent opening.
modes.CONDITIONAL_OPENING_MEDIATED: The body-region exposure becomes materially present through an opening/slit/displacement relationship and depends materially on body position or opening realization.
modes.UNKNOWN: The region is genuinely observed but governed evidence is insufficient to decide. ⛔ MUST fail closed wherever the distinction is required for Numeric tier resolution; ⛔ never silently mapped to either other value.

⛔_observation_firewall.rule: ⛔ §7 — an EI-owned VISUAL SEMANTIC observation of the physical realization relationship, never inferred from a downstream token.
⛔_observation_firewall.⛔_length_and_slit: ⛔ `length` is TC-owned and `slit` (parameter 30) is not EI-owned. Neither may derive the qualifier, and neither may be read by the Numeric resolver.

⛔_no_magnitude_vocabulary: ⛔ DR-4 — no Minor/Moderate/Extensive, percentage, pixel area, coordinates, coverage percentage, numeric exposure amount or region-count score.
binding_rules: bound to one specific Class-A region
⛔ Class-B designed openings never auto-create a Class-A qualifier entry
⛔ a missing qualifier is never inferred
legacy records without the qualifier remain parseable
⛔_population_policy: ⛔ §9 — NO mass backfill. Populated only where actual CEO authority exists; absent elsewhere, and absence is read as UNKNOWN.
★_future_vision_semantics: ★ Contract semantics are defined now so a future Producer can emit it. ⛔ External Vision/API calls in this order = 0.
